notes: Front (+Z) = matte black bumper arc; turret 25 mm behind centre. Generic two-tone disc robot: the reference's 'Roomba' wordmark and turret logo are not used, and nothing is derived from it. Story hero stays the app's procedural model; this GLB is for study/inspector/room.

issuesFixed: v1 was uniformly dark (bumper merged with the body): changed to a pale top shell + graphite rim, thicker/longer side brushes
